programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 7 episode 1
programme.desc: The competition begins with a British classic and Mary's technical challenge - a popular cake with a fatless sponge and tricky chocolate work. Finally, the bakers show the judges what they can do with their showstopper. One baker will be crowned star baker, one contestant will be leaving the tent.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 7 episode 2
programme.desc: It’s biscuit week and the bakers signature challenge is to make 24 identical decorated biscuits. The technical challenge requires perfect piping to avoid a crumbling whirl. The showstopper requires precision baking to build a biscuit structure that reveals a little more about each of the bakers

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 7 episode 3
programme.desc: It’s bread week, and Paul Hollywood sets the challenges. First up is the signature challenge - a sweet dough with a twist. The technical challenge has only a basic set of instructions and ingredients. And the final challenge requires three different flours to create a showstopper centrepiece.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 7 episode 4
programme.desc: The bakers really have to rise to the occasion for batter week. The signature challenge is a British favourite. The technical challenge requires a steady hand to master its intricacies. And finally, there is a show-stopper as the bakers are challenged to do their version of a Spanish classic.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 7 episode 5
programme.desc: It is Pastry Week and the remaining bakers face a Danish style breakfast staple. In the technical challenge, the bakers have limited time and instructions to bake a classic British tart. And in the showstopper, a fine pastry which is notoriously difficult to make and even trickier to bake.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 7 episode 6
programme.desc: It's Botanical Week with three challenges inspired by nature. The signature challenge demands sharp citrus flavours and perfect peaks. There’s a leafy technical challenge set by Mr Hollywood. And, finally, the botanical showstopper is a three tier elaborately decorated cake.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 7 episode 7
programme.desc: Dessert Week - three sweet challenges and for starters the bakers face a sweetly filled signature challenge. The technical challenge layers on the pressure as the bakers are tested on a tricky French dessert. And finally there is a multi-bake mini-showstopper that is a bit of a mousse marathon.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 7 episode 8
programme.desc: Tudor Week and three challenges that embrace a time when impressive centre pieces were Tudor showstoppers. The signature is a Tudor classic - pies. In the technical challenge, the bakers face a rather unusual Tudor biscuit. And a showstopper that is a spectacle of marzipan.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 7 episode 9
programme.desc: It’s the semi-final, and Patisserie Week. In the signature challenge, the bakers have to achieve perfect lamination for a difficult French pastry. In the technical challenge, the bakers' are tested with a yeast-based cake. The show-stopper is a multiple mini-cake bake.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.sub-title: The Great British Baking Show Season 7 episode 10
programme.desc: It’s the final, and the tent plays host to three Royal challenges to impress the Queen. The signature challenge sees a return to meringues. For the technical challenge, the bakers have only one recipe instruction. Then the bakers' face their last show-stopper. Who will be crowned champion?
